title: AnalysisReviewRequestedEvent
description: Domain event: AI analysis finished and an expert review has been opened for it. Under the FULL EXPERT GATE policy (KR-019) EVERY analysis result must be approved by an expert before the farmer can see it, so this event is emitted for every successful analysis result — not only low-confidence ones. The platform emits this from the worker→platform bridge after creating the ExpertReview record. Identifiers are runtime UUIDs (see notes.id_format).

event_id.description: Unique event identifier (platform DomainEvent base — uuid4)

occurred_at.description: When the review was requested (ISO 8601 UTC)

Uuid.description: RFC 4122 UUID (runtime identifier format across platform/worker)

AnalysisReviewRequestedData.title: Analysis Review Requested Data
AnalysisReviewRequestedData.description: Identifiers binding the analysis result to the opened expert review.

review_id.description: Expert review record created for this result (expert_reviews.review_id)

dataset_id.description: Dataset (chain of custody, KR-072) the result derives from

confidence_score.description: Model confidence for the result (0-1). Used for review prioritisation/expert matching.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID for tracing related events

causation_id.description: ID of event/command that caused this event

notes.lifecycle: ACTIVE — uyumlu platform üreticisi mevcut. Platform worker→platform bridge (worker_bridge_consumer.py) HER ExpertReview satırı için bu wire olayını yayınlar (AnalysisReviewRequestedV1, expert_gate_events.py → domain.events exchange, routing event.analysis.review_requested). In-process ExpertReviewRequested ayrıca WORM audit için korunur. (SYNC-1 hizalandı 2026-06-15)
notes.full_gate: KR-019 full expert gate: emitted for EVERY analysis result, replacing the prior low-confidence-only escalation. The mission stays in expert-review state and the farmer is NOT notified until expert_review_decided.v1 with an approving outcome.
notes.id_format: Identifiers are RFC 4122 UUID strings to match the running platform/worker wire format (platform DomainEvent base emits str(uuid4); worker emits raw UUID mission_id). The legacy prefixed-ID event schemas (analysis_completed.v1) describe an aspirational scheme not produced at runtime; reconciling them is a separate MAJOR effort.
notes.pii_free: No PII. All references are opaque identifiers (KR-050/KR-071).
